name: fafnir-models
description: Search and review Sketchfab and Poly Haven models with FAFNIR's persistent local graph and attributed downloads.

interface.longDescription: Search 3D models, compare actual evidence, record adoption decisions, and download attributed packages into a local cache. Optional TypeSafe Jev and local AnyJev evaluators.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find 3D models for my scene, compare their visual fit and cost, and record a shortlist in FAFNIR.
